title: Aureline M5 result-summary-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the result-summary-card family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). A result summary card names what it is showing and what scope it exports so a shared summary never silently widens from summary to raw scope and always names whether it includes evidence or only metadata. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
